messages:
Maya (Marketing): planning a quick battlecard refresh focused on 'serving-first' execution. want short rep-ready lines + webinar hooks.
Alex (Product): agree. emphasize predictability + cost, not just latency. cloud vendors sell scale; we sell production economics.
Sam (Sales): reps need a 1-liner and a 2-line opener. also two quick competitor knockouts for discovery.
Owen (Field): add procurement-friendly points: SLA, private deploy options, KMS/HSM, audit logs. a matrix would help.
Priya (Research): bench note: tests across chat/embed/rerank; p95 latency, cost normalized to tokens, continuous batching on. will provide short methods blurb.
Maya (Marketing): deliverables: 1) 1-liner, 2) 2-line, 3) 3 competitor knockouts, 4) webinar hook + format, 5) subject-line variants. owners?
Sam (Sales): I'll draft 1/2/3. will post by EOD.
Owen (Field): I'll own procurement matrix and webinar hook. prefer 30-min exec + 30-min tech breakout.
Alex (Product): Priya, can you prepare the methods blurb we can paste into the battlecard?
Priya (Research): yes. include config highlights: prefix caching for chat, quantization enabled for cost tests, same prompt sets across runs.
Maya (Marketing): example soundbites I sketched:
- 1-liner: "Redwood Inference: serving-first LLM runtime for predictable latency and lower unit cost."
- 2-line: "Production LLMs need predictable latency, cost controls, and rollout safety. Redwood provides a verified runtime, reserved capacity, and observability to keep models economical at scale."
Sam (Sales): solid. add micro-claim about quality monitoring so buyers know we don't trade quality for cost.
Priya (Research): add: "prompt-linked evals and regression alerts."
Sam (Sales): competitor knockouts (draft):
- vs cloud AI platforms: "They provide models + scale; we provide SLA-backed predictability and cost levers for production traffic."
- vs LLM API shops: "Same developer ergonomics but with private deployment, version pinning, and rollback policies."
- vs infra vendors: "No need to stitch runtime, autoscaling, and observability 100% configured and verified."
Owen (Field): webinar hook: "How one customer cut token spend by ~35% while keeping response quality stable." need to confirm NDA. propose 30min exec + 30min live tech demo.
launch-bot: Webinar tentative booking: 2024-07-18 11:00  calendar invite pending.
Maya (Marketing): subject line variants to test:
A: "Cut your LLM inference bill by a third  serving-first tactics"
B: "Keep LLM latency predictable as traffic spikes"
C: "Prod-ready LLMs: rollouts, fallbacks, and cost playbooks"
Alex (Product): recommend A for growth lists, B for platform leads, C for exec invites.
Sam (Sales): I'll run A/B on a 2k list and report CTR + MQLs.
Maya (Marketing): ops asks: create 1-page PDF + 6-slide TLDR. Sam/Owen will review before Friday.
Sam (Sales): will review. adding two objection handlers for pricing and vendor lock-in.
Owen (Field): adding procurement FAQ for security/compliance.
Priya (Research): methods blurb will be in this thread in ~2 hours, with a tiny table of p95 numbers.
Maya (Marketing): great. owners recap: Sam = sales copy + knockouts, Owen = field assets + case study, Priya = bench methods, Alex = product sign-off, Maya = assemble + webinar. locking next Wed. :rocket:
